#ifndef ZEPHYR_DRIVERS_SENSOR_ADLTC2990_ADLTC2990_EMUL_H_
#define ZEPHYR_DRIVERS_SENSOR_ADLTC2990_ADLTC2990_EMUL_H_

#include <zephyr/drivers/emul.h>

/**
 * @brief Set a register value in the ADLTC2990 emulator.
 *
 * @param target Pointer to the emulator instance.
 * @param reg_addr Address of the register to set.
 * @param val Pointer to the value to set.
 */
void adltc2990_emul_set_reg(const struct emul *target, uint8_t reg_addr, const uint8_t *val);

/**
 * @brief Get a register value from the ADLTC2990 emulator.
 *
 * @param target Pointer to the emulator instance.
 * @param reg_addr Address of the register to get.
 * @param val Pointer to the variable to store the value.
 */
void adltc2990_emul_get_reg(const struct emul *target, uint8_t reg_addr, uint8_t *val);

/**
 * @brief Reset the ADLTC2990 emulator to its initial state.
 *
 * @param target Pointer to the emulator instance.
 */
void adltc2990_emul_reset(const struct emul *target);

#endif /* ZEPHYR_DRIVERS_SENSOR_ADLTC2990_ADLTC2990_EMUL_H_ */
